skins.name: Like Illusion
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "The Curious Trove Manor" Custom Line/Like Illusion
skins.description: The actor plays the role of the maid who guards the treasure. In a sea of roaming shadows of a hundred and one forms, all truest true and falsest false, the willful intruder finds himself endlessly dithering about the stairs.

skins.name: Mirror Visitor
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "The Curious Trove Manor" Custom Line/Mirror Visitor
skins.description: The actor–hush, now. Does she play the role of the Master, a guest, or a phantom in the mirror? Until the highest landing is reached, all remains a mystery.

skins.name: Trust Your Eyes
skins.code: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script "The Curious Trove Manor" Custom Line/Trust Your Eyes
skins.description: The actor plays the role of a Great Thief Magician, here for the treasure. No, come now–doubt those eyes of yours. Trust his hands.
